parameters.content:
## 01 - Pin Resolver Probe (read-only)

**Why this exists.** Pinterest board RSS does *not* publish a pin's
outbound link. Verified on a real board: 26 pins, 0 Etsy links. The
feed only carries the pin URL, the image and the description.

So the Etsy link has to come from the **pin page** itself, where
Pinterest embeds it in a JSON blob.

**The question this answers:** can the n8n server fetch a pin page
and read that link, or does Pinterest serve a bot wall?

POST to the webhook:
`{"pin_urls":["https://www.pinterest.com/pin/<id>/"]}`

Capped at 10 pins per call. Writes nothing.

nodes.name: Pins To Resolve
nodes.notes: Expands the posted pin_urls into one item each. Batch capped at 10.

nodes.name: Fetch Pin Page
nodes.notes: Browser-like headers. neverError so a bot wall is reported, not fatal.

parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

nodes.name: Extract Destination
nodes.notes: Reads the Etsy link out of the page JSON. Distinguishes "blocked" from "no link" from "destination is not Etsy".
